def load():

def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); hh,ww=g.shape
    vals,bins=np.unique(g,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[np.argmax(bins)])
    pts=np.argwhere(g!=bg)
    lo,hi=int(pts[:,0].min()),int(pts[:,0].max()); bz,wz=int(pts[:,1].min()),int(pts[:,1].max())
    out=g.copy()
    for r in range(lo+1,hi):
        for c in range(bz+1,wz):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=4
    def ray(r,c,d):
        rr,cc=r+d[0],c+d[1]
        while 0<=rr<hh and 0<=cc<ww:
            if out[rr][cc]!=bg: break
            out[rr][cc]=4; rr+=d[0]; cc+=d[1]
    # gap on left wall: paint from (r,bz-1) diagonals, from interior corners (lo,bz) etc also
    def paint_from(scs):
        for r,c in scs:
            for dr,dc in dcs_list:
                ray(r,c,(dr,dc))
    dcs_list=[(-1,-1),(1,-1)] if 'L'==side else [(-1,1),(1,1)]
    for side,(bc_) in [('L',bz),('R',wz)]:
        gr=[r for r in range(lo,hi+1) if g[r][bc_]==bg]
        paint_from([(r,bc_-1) for r in gr])  # rays start just outside the gap, going away diagonally
    # fill entire rows/cols spanned by shape's bbox (the "shadow")
    allp=[]
    for side,(bc_) in [('L',bz),('R',wz)]:
        gr=[r for r in range(lo,hi+1) if g[r][bc_]==bg]
        if side=='L': allp+=[(r,bc_-1) for r in gr]
        else: allp+=[(r,bc_+1) for r in gr]
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in out]
# actually simpler hypothesis: changed cells = bbox minus original + diagonal rays from every gap cell outward. Verify demo 1 exactly:
def verify(k):
    i=np.array(G[k+' input']); o=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    lo,hi,i2,j2=i.shape[0],i.shape[1]
    vals,_=np.unique(i,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[np.argmax(np.bincount(i.flat))])
    pts=np.argwhere(i!=bg)
    ll,hh=int(pts[:,0].min()),int(pts[:,0].max()); lw,rw=int(pts[:,1].min()),int(pts[:,1].max())
    s=solve([row[:] for row in i]); e=G[k+' output']
    a=np.array(s)
    print(k,"bbox",ll,hh,lw,rw, "changed match" , np.array_equal(a,o))

def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); hh,ww=g.shape
    bg=int(np.bincount(g.flat).argmax())
    S=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(g!=bg)))
    # seed: bg cells with a shape cell left and right in same row
    seeds=set()
    for r,c in map(tuple,S):
        pass
    for r in range(hh):
        ls=[c for c in range(ww) if (r,c) in S]; rs=[c for c in range(ww) if (r,c) in S]
        pass
    seeds={((r,c)) for r in range(hh) for c in range(ww) if g[r][c]==bg
           and min([x for x in rs if x<c],default=None) is not None and max([x for x in rs if x>c],default=None) is not None}
    painted=set(seeds)
    frontier=set(seeds)
    while frontier:
        p=frontier.pop()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            rr,cc=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
            while 0<=rr<hh and 0<=cc<ww and (rr,cc) not in S:
                q=(rr,cc)
                if q in painted: continue
                painted.add(q); frontier.add(q)
                rr,cc=q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc
    out=g.copy()
    for r,c in painted: out[r][c]=4
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in out]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    s=solve(G[k+' input']); e=G[k+' output']
    print(k, s==e)
